Generic methods for spei objects.

Source: R/spei.R
Generic-methods-for-spei-objects.Rd

Generic methods for extracting information and plotting spei objects.

See print.spei

See print.spei

Usage

# S3 method for class 'spei'
print(x, ...)
# S3 method for class 'spei'
summary(object, ...)
# S3 method for class 'spei'
plot(x, main = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'spei'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'spei'
plot(x, main = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

an object of class spei.

...

additional parameters, not used at present.

object

an object of class spei.

main

optional, a character string with the plot title.

Details

These functions allow extracting information and plotting spei objects. print yields the fitted values, i.e. a time series of SPEI or SPI values. summary reports the function call, the parameters of the PDF used, and the time series of SPEI or SPI values. plot produces a plot of the time series of SPEI or SPI values, with blue and red colors for positive and negative values, respectively. If a reference period was used in the function call it is shown by a shaded area. In the event that NA or Inf values were produced, these are shown by circles. The plot is a ggplot2 object, so it can be further modified by adding ggplot2 layers or themes.

These are S3 methods: call them as print(x), summary(x) and plot(x). The method functions themselves (e.g. plot.spei) are not exported.
